definition_en: A pipe or small structure that carries water under a road, driveway, railway, or embankment.
explanation_ru: Водопропускное сооружение под дорогой, подъездом или насыпью. Чаще всего это труба, по которой вода из канавы проходит на другую сторону.
example_en: Install a 300 mm culvert under the driveway and restore the ditch line.
scenario: Ditch water must pass beneath a driveway without flowing over the road surface.
visual: Road cross-section with a pipe beneath it connecting ditches on both sides, arrows showing water flow.
common_mistakes: A culvert usually conveys open-channel drainage under an obstruction; it is not automatically the same as a storm sewer main.

definition_en: A shallow open channel used to collect and carry surface water.
explanation_ru: Открытая канава для сбора и отвода поверхностной воды вдоль дороги, площадки или границы участка.
example_en: Regrade the roadside ditch to maintain positive drainage to the culvert.
scenario: Rainwater is carried in an open channel beside the roadway.
visual: Road shoulder beside a V-shaped open channel with water flowing toward a culvert.

definition_en: A drainage inlet that collects surface runoff and directs it into a storm sewer, often with a sump for sediment.
explanation_ru: Дождеприёмный колодец, который принимает воду с поверхности и направляет её в ливневую систему. Часто имеет отстойную часть для песка и мусора.
example_en: Connect the new catch basin to the existing storm main with a 200 mm lead.
scenario: Water from pavement enters a grated box and then flows into underground storm piping.
visual: Pavement with grated inlet above a box connected by pipe to a storm main.
common_mistakes: A catch basin collects surface water; a manhole is mainly for access and junctions.

definition_en: An access structure on an underground utility system used for inspection, maintenance, direction changes, or pipe junctions.
explanation_ru: Колодец доступа к подземной сети для осмотра, обслуживания, изменения направления или соединения труб.
example_en: Set the sanitary manhole to the rim and invert elevations shown on the drawings.
scenario: Workers need a vertical access point to inspect underground pipes at a junction.
visual: Round access cover at grade over a vertical chamber with incoming and outgoing pipes.

definition_en: The inside bottom elevation of a pipe or channel, used to define drainage grades and flow direction.
explanation_ru: Отметка внутреннего низа трубы или канала. По invert elevations проверяют уклон и направление самотечного потока.
example_en: Verify the downstream invert before ordering the manhole base.
scenario: You need the elevation of the lowest inside point of a gravity pipe.
visual: Pipe cross-section with an arrow pointing to the lowest inside point and an elevation label.
common_mistakes: Do not confuse pipe invert with pipe crown or outside bottom elevation.

definition_en: An underground pipe system that carries rainwater and surface runoff to an outlet or drainage facility.
explanation_ru: Подземная ливневая сеть из труб и колодцев для отвода дождевой и поверхностной воды.
example_en: Tie the new catch basin lead into the existing storm sewer.
scenario: Several catch basins discharge into an underground gravity pipe network.
visual: Several street catch basins connected to one larger underground storm pipe.

definition_en: A main underground pressurized pipe that distributes potable or service water through a utility network.
explanation_ru: Основная напорная водопроводная труба, по которой вода распределяется по сети.
example_en: Maintain the required separation between the proposed storm sewer and the existing watermain.
scenario: A pressurized municipal pipe supplies water to multiple service connections.
visual: Large underground blue pipe with smaller service branches leading toward buildings.

definition_en: A grouped system of conduits, usually encased in concrete, installed underground for electrical or communication cables.
explanation_ru: Группа подземных кабельных труб, часто уложенных блоком и залитых бетоном для защиты электрических или телекоммуникационных кабелей.
example_en: Excavate, install conduits, and concrete-encase the duct bank to the transformer pad.
scenario: Multiple electrical conduits are bundled underground and protected with concrete.
visual: Trench cross-section showing several conduits in rows inside a rectangular concrete encasement.

definition_en: A protective tube or raceway used to carry electrical or communication cables.
explanation_ru: Защитная труба или канал, внутри которого прокладывают электрические или телекоммуникационные кабели.
example_en: Provide two spare conduits through the road crossing.
scenario: Cable needs a protective pipe before being pulled underground.
visual: Cable being pulled through a round conduit in an underground trench.

definition_en: A narrow excavation, typically deeper than it is wide, made for pipes, utilities, foundations, or drainage work.
explanation_ru: Узкая выемка грунта, обычно для прокладки труб, кабелей, инженерных сетей или устройства основания.
example_en: Excavate the trench to the required depth and prepare the pipe bedding.
scenario: A narrow excavation is opened along an alignment for underground pipe installation.
visual: Long narrow excavation with spoil pile on one side and a pipe being installed at the bottom.

definition_en: A protective shield placed in an excavation to protect workers from cave-ins; it does not necessarily support the trench walls.
explanation_ru: Защитный металлический короб в траншее, который защищает работников при обрушении грунта. Сам по себе он не обязательно удерживает стенки траншеи.
example_en: Use a trench box for pipe installation where the excavation depth requires protective measures.
scenario: Workers must enter a deep trench and need protection from cave-in hazards.
visual: Worker standing inside a steel trench shield placed within a deep excavation.
common_mistakes: A trench box shields workers; shoring is intended to support or restrain excavation walls.

definition_en: A temporary support system used to stabilize excavation walls or structures and prevent collapse.
explanation_ru: Временная система крепления и поддержки стенок котлована, траншеи или конструкций для предотвращения обрушения.
example_en: Include temporary shoring where the excavation cannot be safely sloped back.
scenario: The excavation walls must be physically supported because there is no room to flatten the side slopes.
visual: Vertical excavation wall held by steel posts and horizontal walers with braces.

definition_en: Removing groundwater or surface water from an excavation so work can proceed in dry and stable conditions.
explanation_ru: Откачка или понижение воды в котловане или траншее, чтобы вести работы в сухих и устойчивых условиях.
example_en: Allow for dewatering during installation of the deep storm line.
scenario: Groundwater is entering the excavation faster than pipe crews can work.
visual: Pump hose removing water from the bottom of an excavation into a discharge line.

definition_en: The removal of soil, rock, or other material to create space or reach a required elevation.
explanation_ru: Разработка и выемка грунта или другого материала до нужной формы и отметки.
example_en: The estimate includes excavation, loading, hauling, and disposal of unsuitable material.
scenario: Material must be removed to lower the site to design grade.
visual: Excavator removing soil from a cut area while a dump truck waits nearby.

definition_en: Material placed back into an excavation after a pipe, structure, or utility has been installed.
explanation_ru: Материал обратной засыпки, которым заполняют траншею или котлован после монтажа трубы, сооружения или сети.
example_en: Backfill the trench in compacted lifts after the pipe passes inspection.
scenario: After utility installation, the open trench must be filled and compacted.
visual: Pipe in trench with successive layers of fill placed above it and compaction arrows.

definition_en: The prepared natural soil or engineered fill surface that supports the pavement or other structural layers above it.
explanation_ru: Подготовленное грунтовое основание, на которое затем укладывают subbase, base course или другие конструктивные слои.
example_en: Proof-roll the subgrade before placing granular subbase.
scenario: The earth surface has been shaped and compacted and is ready for the first granular pavement layer.
visual: Road section with natural/engineered soil labeled subgrade beneath granular layers.
common_mistakes: Subgrade is the prepared soil surface; subbase is a placed aggregate layer above it.

definition_en: A granular layer placed above the subgrade and below the base course or pavement to improve support and drainage.
explanation_ru: Нижний слой щебёночного или гравийного основания между грунтом и верхними слоями дорожной конструкции.
example_en: Place and compact 300 mm of granular subbase over the approved subgrade.
scenario: A thick granular layer is installed on prepared soil before the road base and asphalt.
visual: Road cross-section with subgrade at bottom, thick granular subbase above, then base and asphalt.

definition_en: Granular material such as sand, gravel, crushed rock, or stone used in concrete, road bases, drainage, and backfill.
explanation_ru: Зернистый материал: песок, гравий, щебень или дроблёный камень, используемый для оснований, бетона, дренажа и засыпки.
example_en: Import approved aggregate for the road base and trench backfill.
scenario: Crushed rock is being supplied for a compacted road layer.
visual: Stockpile of crushed stone beside a road section showing granular layers.

definition_en: Densifying soil or aggregate by mechanical effort to reduce voids and improve strength and stability.
explanation_ru: Уплотнение грунта или щебня механическим оборудованием для повышения плотности, несущей способности и устойчивости.
example_en: Compact the backfill in lifts to the specified density.
scenario: A roller or plate tamper is used repeatedly over placed fill to increase density.
visual: Plate compactor working over layered backfill with arrows showing densification.

definition_en: A straight cut made through asphalt or concrete, usually to create a clean removal or tie-in edge.
explanation_ru: Пропил асфальта или бетона пилой для получения ровной границы демонтажа или примыкания.
example_en: Sawcut the existing asphalt before removing pavement for the utility trench.
scenario: A clean straight edge is required before breaking out existing pavement.
visual: Road saw cutting a straight line through asphalt ahead of excavation.

definition_en: A connection between new work and an existing utility, pavement, structure, or system.
explanation_ru: Место и операция подключения новой сети или конструкции к существующей системе.
example_en: Coordinate the watermain tie-in and shutdown with the owner.
scenario: The new pipe must be connected into an existing live municipal line.
visual: New pipe approaching an existing main with a highlighted connection point.

definition_en: Removing a controlled thickness of existing asphalt pavement using a milling machine.
explanation_ru: Фрезерование существующего асфальта на заданную глубину перед устройством нового слоя покрытия.
example_en: Mill 40 mm of existing asphalt before placing the new overlay.
scenario: A machine removes the top layer of asphalt while leaving the lower pavement structure in place.
visual: Cold planer removing a thin top layer of asphalt with a truck collecting millings.

definition_en: A new pavement layer placed over an existing pavement surface to restore or improve it.
explanation_ru: Новый слой асфальта, который укладывают поверх существующего покрытия после подготовки или фрезерования.
example_en: Place a 40 mm asphalt overlay across the full lane width.
scenario: Existing pavement remains in place and receives a new asphalt surface layer.
visual: Road cross-section showing old asphalt with a thinner fresh asphalt layer on top.

definition_en: A combined concrete edge and drainage channel installed along a roadway to define the pavement edge and convey runoff.
explanation_ru: Комбинированный бетонный бордюр с лотком вдоль дороги: удерживает край покрытия и направляет поверхностную воду.
translation_vi: bó vỉa và rãnh thoát nước
example_en: Replace damaged curb and gutter after the utility crossing is backfilled.
scenario: Concrete along the road edge both contains pavement and channels runoff toward catch basins.
visual: Road edge cross-section with raised curb and sloped gutter carrying water toward an inlet.

definition_en: A linear referencing system used on civil drawings to identify positions along an alignment, commonly written like 1+250.
explanation_ru: Система линейной привязки по трассе. Например, STA 1+250 означает точку на определённом расстоянии от начала оси.
example_en: The storm crossing is shown near Station 1+240.
scenario: You need to locate a feature at a specific distance along a roadway centerline.
visual: Plan-view alignment with tick marks labeled 1+200, 1+250 and 1+300.

definition_en: A fixed reference point with a known elevation used for surveying and construction layout.
explanation_ru: Закреплённая точка с известной отметкой, от которой геодезисты переносят высоты на объекте.
example_en: Confirm the site benchmark before setting excavation grades.
scenario: Survey crews need a reliable known elevation from which to establish other elevations.
visual: Survey marker with known elevation and a level instrument transferring elevation to the work area.

definition_en: The process of measuring and calculating quantities of work or materials from drawings, specifications, and other tender documents.
explanation_ru: Процесс измерения объёмов работ и материалов по чертежам и тендерной документации для последующей оценки стоимости.
example_en: Complete the quantity takeoff for storm pipe, manholes, excavation, and asphalt restoration.
scenario: An estimator measures lengths, areas, counts and volumes from civil drawings before pricing.
visual: Plan drawing with colored measurement lines, area polygons, counts, and a quantity summary table.

definition_en: A defined line item in a bid or estimate representing a specific portion of work, usually with a unit, quantity, and price.
explanation_ru: Отдельная позиция сметы или тендера с определённым видом работ, единицей измерения, количеством и ценой.
example_en: Assign the culvert installation quantity to the correct bid item.
scenario: A tender form contains separate payable lines for pipe, manholes, asphalt and excavation.
visual: Estimate table with columns for bid item number, description, unit, quantity and price.

definition_en: An amount included in an estimate or contract for work or cost that is not fully defined at the time of pricing.
explanation_ru: Заложенная сумма на работу или расход, который пока нельзя точно определить. Обычно условия тендера или контракта определяют, как allowance используется и корректируется.
example_en: Carry the specified allowance separately from the measured bid items.
scenario: The owner requires a fixed amount to be included for a scope that is not yet fully designed.
visual: Estimate sheet showing a separate allowance line with a note that scope is to be confirmed.
common_mistakes: An allowance is usually a defined contract amount for uncertain scope; contingency is generally a risk reserve and may be treated differently.

definition_en: A description of the work, responsibilities, limits, inclusions, and sometimes exclusions assigned to a contractor or subcontractor.
explanation_ru: Описание того, какие именно работы входят в обязанность подрядчика: границы, включения, ответственность и иногда исключения.
example_en: Review the scope of work before sending the RFQ to subcontractors.
scenario: You must determine exactly which tasks are included before pricing or requesting a quote.
visual: Checklist divided into included work, excluded work, interfaces, and responsibilities.

definition_en: Request for Quotation: a formal request asking a supplier or subcontractor to provide pricing for a defined scope.
explanation_ru: Запрос цены у поставщика или субподрядчика на конкретный объём работ или материалов.
example_en: Send the asphalt RFQ with the drawings, quantities, scope notes, and closing date.
scenario: An estimator needs subcontractor or supplier pricing before bid day.
visual: Email package with drawings, scope sheet, quantity list and a quotation response arrow.
